title: Association between Sleep Duration and Incident Diabetes Mellitus in Healthy Subjects: A 14-Year Longitudinal Cohort Study.
authors: Jang JH, Kim W, Moon JS, Roh E, Kang JG, Lee SJ, Ihm SH, Huh JH.
figures: Multivariable-adjusted hazard ratios of sleep duration with risk of type 2 diabetes, evaluated by restricted cubic splines from Cox proportional hazards models.
